author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Checks public chat, keeps a list of viewers you trust, and can optionally take small, rate-limited moderation steps.
changelog: 4.1.8: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.8, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. Unreleased: added a privacy-safe moderation dashboard with filtered and paginated incidents, action outcomes, salted viewer fingerprints, inline reviews, and bounded report download. 2.5.0: added a disabled !guardtrust Streamer.bot command, wizard trusted-viewer manager, enforcement platform/rule selection, minimum-match threshold, per-viewer cooldown, safer guided setup, and regenerated imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline. 2.4.2: initial disabled-by-default observe-only release with bounded pseudonymous incident state.

manifest.name: Chat Guard

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Chat Guard - Trust Viewer

installationSteps: Enable safe observation, select the public-chat platforms to watch, optionally enter obvious blocked words or websites, then save and restart. Observation cannot moderate anyone.
Import the matching Chat Guard Streamer.bot package. Leave both helpers triggerless; the legacy !guardtrust Command object may remain disabled.
Use the rule tester and privacy-safe moderation dashboard. Filter incidents and label false positives before changing enforcement rules.
To trust one viewer, reply to their message with !guardtrust as the broadcaster or a moderator. It works through your main chat connection after restart.
Optional: approve Moderate, turn on both automatic-action safety switches, and begin with Warn. Use delete, timeout, or ban only after genuine live acceptance.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private, anonymous incident records are kept for a later reinstall or for you to review.

healthChecks.description: Checks that public chat checks work and that optional moderation stays off if anything looks wrong.
